welcome.title: Welcome to ALXS-RL-Mod
welcome.subtitle: Before you start, here is what the app does to your game.

points.files: It edits Rocket League's local files (item swaps, palettes, decals, ball, maps). No injection, no network interception.
points.local: Changes are visible only to you: other players see your real items.
points.restore: Every change is backed up and can be undone (Settings › Restore the stock game).
points.affiliation: ALXS-RL-Mod is a fan-made tool, not affiliated with or endorsed by Psyonix or Epic Games.

welcome.risk: Modifying game files goes against the game's terms of use. Use it at your own risk: the authors are not responsible for any action taken on your account.

keys.title: Package keys (keys.txt)
keys.subtitle: Needed for item swaps, custom decals and the ball.
keys.why: Rocket League encrypts part of its package files. To read and swap items, the app needs the AES keys listed in a keys.txt file (one key per line).
keys.where: The app cannot ship these keys. They are shared by the Rocket League modding community (for example alongside package tools like RLUPKTool): get an up-to-date keys.txt, then import it here.
keys.updates: Game updates add new keys: if new items don't work after an update, import a newer keys.txt. Maps, palettes and the tracker work without keys.
